title: 1688 Product & Supplier Finder — development preview
description: Quickstart: enter product keywords or numeric Offer IDs, then start. IDs take priority when provided. Image search and search-results links are not supported. The Actor uses its own browser and chargeable Apify residential proxies by default. Live collection is not yet release-validated.

keywords.title: Search keywords (English or Chinese)
keywords.description: Enter one product name per line. Replace the example with your products. Each keyword is searched separately. These keywords are ignored when Offer IDs are provided. Titles are collected as displayed; automatic translation is not included.

offerIds.title: Offer IDs
offerIds.description: Already know the products? Enter their numeric 1688 product IDs, one per line. For detail.1688.com/offer/1071313125369.html, enter 1071313125369. IDs take priority: keyword search is skipped. Do not paste full URLs. The Actor reads supported public detail fields; login-only details are not collected.

maxResults.title: Maximum products per keyword
maxResults.description: Maximum unique products from each keyword, not the whole run. 10,000 is a hard ceiling, not an unlimited setting or a guarantee. Collection also stops at the page limit or last page. Ignored for Offer IDs.

maxPagesPerKeyword.title: Maximum pages per keyword
maxPagesPerKeyword.description: Click Next page until this limit, the product target or the last available page is reached. Offer IDs open individual products and do not use this setting.

orderQuantity.title: How many items do you plan to order?
orderQuantity.description: Compare your planned quantity with the displayed minimum order quantity (MOQ). Does not turn listing or variant prices into a confirmed order quotation.

useApifyProxy.title: Use Apify residential proxies
useApifyProxy.description: Use the RESIDENTIAL proxy group and the country below. Traffic costs are billed through Apify. Requires proxy access and available country coverage. Does not guarantee 1688 access or dismiss verification.

proxyCountryMode.title: Residential proxy country
proxyCountryMode.description: Select one country for the run. Availability depends on your Apify account and the proxy pool. The Actor keeps one configured session and does not automatically switch countries or identities after login, verification or access denial. Ignored when proxies are disabled.

failOnNoResults.title: Stop on the first collection error
failOnNoResults.description: When off, continue after ordinary layout/not-found errors and retain valid earlier products. Runs with no products always fail. Login, verification and access-denied responses always stop the run.

saveCsvFile.title: Save CSV download files
saveCsvFile.description: Save a product CSV and 1688_suppliers.csv under Storage → Key-value store. The dataset and run-summary files are separate.

csvFilename.title: Product CSV filename
csvFilename.description: Use a simple .csv filename. 1688_suppliers.csv is reserved for the separate supplier shortlist.
